# Colorado Hiker Girl

> > A personal hiking blog documenting Colorado mountain adventures, 13ers, 14ers, and trail explorations throughout the Front Range and beyond.

Colorado Hiker Girl is Jennifer's hiking journal featuring detailed trail reports from Colorado's mountains, including summits like Quandary Peak and Mt. Sniktau, plus hiking goals like the 52 hike challenge. The blog shares experiences from beginner-friendly trails near Denver to challenging alpine peaks along I-70 and Guanella Pass.

## Key Topics

- Colorado hiking
- 14ers (fourteeners)
- 13ers (thirteeners)
- Guanella Pass
- Trail reports
- 52 hike challenge
- Winter hiking
- Above treeline hiking
- Backpacking
- Mt. Bierstadt
- Quandary Peak
- Front Range trails
- Denver area hikes
- Beginner-friendly summits
- Alpine hiking

- [Colorado Hiker Girl – Exploring Colorado's Mountains by Foot](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com): Homepage featuring Colorado hiking adventures, 13ers, 14ers & trail goals
- [Home – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/home): Welcome page with latest blog posts and Instagram feed from trailtomountain

- [Dear Fellow Hiker – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/03/dear-fellow-hiker): Jennifer's story: from New England to Colorado hiking blogger & journaler
- [Blog – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/blog): Blog archive with Colorado trail reports, trip summaries & hiking updates

## 14ers & Major Peak Summits

- [Quandary Peak – 8/21/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/25/quandary-peak-8-21-2020): Quandary Peak 14er summit: 6.5mi climb, second fourteener achievement

## 13ers & Alpine Hikes

- [Square Top Mountain – 9/6/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/12/30/square-top-mountain-9-6-2020): Square Top Mountain 13er summit via Guanella Pass in Pike National Forest
- [Mt. Flora – 6/28/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/27/mt-flora-6-28-2020): Mt. Flora 13er summit: 6.2mi alpine hike from Berthoud Pass trailhead
- [Mt. Sniktau – 6/23/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/31/mt-sniktau-6-23-2020): Mt. Sniktau 13er: 3.7mi beginner-friendly summit from Loveland Pass
- [Hoosier Pass Loop Trail – 7/19/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/08/hoosier-pass-loop-trail-7-19-2020): Hoosier Pass loop: 3mi above treeline with 14er views & mining ruins

## Front Range & Moderate Trails

- [Chief Mountain – 8/20/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/23/chief-mountain-8-20-2020): Chief Mountain trail report: 2.8mi moderate hike off Squaw Pass Road
- [Mayflower Gulch Trail – 8/9/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/08/22/mayflower-gulch-trail-8-9-2020): Mayflower Gulch trail report: 5.4mi with wildflowers near Copper Mountain
- [Meyer Ranch Park overview – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2020/09/07/meyer-ranch-park-overview): Meyer Ranch Park in Conifer: easy 2.3mi dog-friendly loop near Denver
- [Watrous Gulch – 9/20/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2021/01/01/watrousgulch9202020): Watrous Gulch trail near Eisenhower Tunnel: fall colors & hiking challenges

## Winter & Seasonal Hiking

- [Burning Bear Trail – 12/5/2020 – Colorado Hiker Girl](https://coloradohikergirl.wordpress.com/2021/01/07/burningbeartrail1252020): Burning Bear Trail winter gem: 5mi snow hike at Guanella Pass with solitude
